build.exporter_settings: glTF binary, export_animation_mode=ACTIONS, morph targets on, skins on (4 influences), vertex colours NONE, slide-to-zero, sampled 30 fps

global_info.armature_node: root (scale 0.01: joint data in cm, scene in metres)
global_info.root_motion: locomotion clips (Idle, Walk_Fwd, Run_Fwd, Walk_Back): none, in place - move the character root in the app; one-shot clips (Squat, Jump, ToPlank, ToBridge): small baked pelvis displacement, see per-clip root_motion

morph_targets.note: ARKit set as in Xandra_Animated.glb; slots 25/26 are named mouthSmileLeftold / mouthSmileRightold (no mouthSmileRight / tongueOut names)

global_info.skin_influences: max 4 per vertex (exporter keeps the 4 strongest, renormalised)
global_info.loop_convention: loop:true clips have last key == first key; loop with time modulo duration_s (three.js LoopRepeat). loop:false clips: play once (LoopOnce + clampWhenFinished)
global_info.note_glb_animation_order: glTF animations[] are stored alphabetically by the exporter: Idle, Jump, Run_Fwd, Squat, ToBridge, ToPlank, Walk_Back, Walk_Fwd; look clips up by name, not index
global_info.replaced: old clip 'Walk' (Xandra_Walk) is replaced by Walk_Fwd and is no longer in the file
global_info.materials: Skin/eyes/teeth/hair materials JSON identical to the previous (no-clothes) Xandra_Animated.glb incl. the brown hair tint baseColorFactor [0.1697, 0.1006, 0.0921, 1]; no COLOR_0 vertex colours; MI_BlueUnderwear removed; two fabric materials added (see clothing)

clothing.version: v5 (approved look: V-neck crop sports top with rounded, partially bridged bust - slight nipple relief accepted by Ilya; yoga shorts)
clothing.source: built from Xandra's own body topology (top: F4_Torso + F4_Head shoulder strip; shorts: F4_Legs_Censored surface) by /workspace/XandraAnimation/clothes/c12_build_clothes.py (+ garmentlib.py, bustgrid.py); no third-party garment assets downloaded or used
clothing.license: original work made for this project (see /workspace/XandraAnimation/mocap/LICENSES.txt, section Clothing)

Xandra_Top.construction: double shell (1.3 mm fabric) with rim; rolled 5-6 mm edges at neck/armholes; 2.4 cm hem band; 1.2 mm min offset over the skin

Xandra_Shorts.construction: double shell (1.3 mm) with rim; 3.8 cm waistband + rolled waist edge; rolled leg hems (mid-thigh)

materials.MI_Xandra_Top_Fabric: Principled/glTF PBR, baseColorFactor linear (0.0168, 0.0513, 0.195) dark blue, metallic 0, roughness 0.72, KHR_materials_sheen (0.35 weight in Blender; sheenColor (0.75,0.8,1), sheenRoughness 0.5), no textures
materials.MI_Xandra_Shorts_Fabric: Principled/glTF PBR, baseColorFactor linear (0.0075, 0.011, 0.0242) near-black navy, metallic 0, roughness 0.70, KHR_materials_sheen, no textures

clothing.rigging: skinned to the same `root` skin (341 joints); weights = nearest-face barycentric transfer from the body (same rule as Data Transfer POLYINTERP_NEAREST) using the body's top-4 weights, limited to 4 influences, normalised
clothing.removed: Blue_Underwear mesh and MI_BlueUnderwear material are no longer exported (hidden in the blend)

body_faces_removed_in_export.rule: export session only (blend body intact): body vertices >= 5-6 mm inside every garment edge (2.2 cm at the V-neck, 1.2 cm for the neck edge on F4_Head) whose whole 1-ring is >= 2 mm inside the garment, so every removed face lies fully under the fabric
body_faces_removed_in_export.F4_Head_note: only shoulder-skin vertices under the straps (z < 1.43 m); they carry no displacement (> 1 mm) in any of the 52 exported morphs; face/head untouched; all 52 morph targets kept with identical names

poke_through_check.method: body vertices >=4 mm inside a garment edge (rest-pose cut fields) of the exported body (F4_Torso, F4_Head<1.47 m, F4_Legs_Nude) still present in the GLB; every 2nd + last frame of each clip; a vertex is a poke-through if its signed distance to the nearest face of the skinned garment OUTER shell is >0 (within 3 cm) AND a ray along its deformed normal (3 cm) hits no garment face (exposed skin). Ray hits are counted separately: leaving through an outer face = inside the fabric thickness (not visible); hitting the inner shell = covered (crease/fold false positive of the nearest-face test)
poke_through_check.note: residual: small skin push-through (<= 3.8 mm) at 2-3 spots: front armhole corners (Idle/Walk/Run, mostly hidden by the arm) and the shorts waist sides in deep hip flexion (Squat/ToPlank); see validation/clothes
